data.smt_query:
; Freehold SMT-LIB query
(set-logic ALL)
(declare-const PaymentDeclined Int)
(declare-const amount Int)
(declare-const error Int)
(declare-const success Int)
(assert (> amount 0))
(assert (not (or success (= error PaymentDeclined))))
(check-sat)
; unsat means proved
